DEWALT DCW604NT-XJ 18V XR cordless router/trimmer offers powerful, precise performance for diverse woodworking tasks, powered by a high-efficiency brushless motor for extended runtime and consistent power. Ideal for a variety of tasks including routing for inlay cavities, hinge mortises, edge rounding and flush trimming. Variable speed control and soft start provide precise adjustment and smooth operation, and an integrated dust extraction facility keeps the work area clean and improves visibility. Ergonomically designed for comfort and balance, ithe cordless router also features a tool-free depth adjustment system for quick, accurate changes. Supplied in a durable TSTAK kit box. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
